name: gadget-deployment
intent: Stowed GRAPPLE tile unfolds a clipped tray panel; FIRE/REEL pulse status labels after deploy.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Tray and controls appear immediately; no clip-path unfold

acceptance: Idle: GRAPPLE tile visible; tray and FIRE/REEL controls hidden; live region reads stowed
DEPLOY triggers clip-path tray unfold over 520ms; tile face dims; live announces unfolding
Done: tray shows GRAPPLE UNIT + STATUS — READY; FIRE/REEL enabled outside tile
FIRE pulses STATUS — FIRING (accent) for 480ms then returns READY; live announces fired
REEL pulses STATUS — REELING (primary) for 480ms then returns READY; live announces reeling
RESET stows tray, hides controls, re-enables DEPLOY
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) skips unfold animation
No network; effect stays inside host panel
waveB: FIRE/REEL are sibling controls (not nested in tile); status pulses are one-shot, not toggles
